description: Create a property tax assessment appeal package. Create a spreadsheet at /home/ga/Documents/Spreadsheets/property_comparison.xlsx comparing your home (assessed at $425,000) with 4 comparable properties in the neighborhood. Include calculated columns for $/sq ft using formulas, and summary calculations for average comparable value, fair assessment, and over-assessment amount. Then create a formal business letter at /home/ga/Documents/TextDocuments/tax_appeal_letter.docx to the County Board of Equalization requesting a reassessment, referencing the comparison data. Save both files.
